Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Manoj Vaibhav Gems 'N' Jewellers Limited reported strong financial results for Q4 FY25 with a year-on-year quarterly turnover increase of 29.0% to INR705.10 crore and a PAT increase of 30.1% to INR26.75 crore. Management highlighted that gold price volatility and high prices impacted gross margins and walk-ins, leading to the deployment of extra discounts and schemes. To capture growing demand and diversify beyond gold, the company plans to open close to 10 silver jewelry showrooms and an ultra-premium 'Visesha' gold jewelry showroom in Visakhapatnam by September. Furthermore, management anticipates continuing an annual revenue growth rate of around 10% to 12% in the coming financial year. Manoj Vaibhav Gems 'N' Jewellers Limited reported financial and operational results for the fourth quarter and year ended March 31, 2025, highlighting revenue growth, store network expansion, and inventory trends.

guidance.claim: Management expects to continue a normal annual revenue growth rate of about 10% to 12% for the financial year.
guidance.quote: It is a normal growth of 10% in 10 years, sir.

guidance.claim: The company targets a first-year revenue of at least INR150 crores to INR200 crores for the upcoming Visesha showroom in Visakhapatnam.
guidance.quote: Sir, we are trying to at least do around INR200 crores, at least INR150 crores to INR200 crores minimum would be the first year target is what we are planning.

demand_outlook.claim: Gold prices remained volatile throughout the fourth quarter and continued their upward trajectory.
demand_outlook.quote: As seen in the previous quarter, gold price remained volatile throughout the Q4 and continued the upward trajectory.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted a decline in general walk-ins and window shoppers due to very high gold prices.
demand_outlook.quote: So, one thing is, so because the gold prices have gone so high, the general walk-ins on the window shoppers, we definitely see some kind of decline in them.

demand_outlook.claim: The company has observed a steady increase in demand for silver jewelry over the past two to three years.
demand_outlook.quote: So, yes when it comes to business point of view, so definitely we have seen a very good response for silver jewelry in past 2, 3 years, where we try tested with few exhibitions and few pieces with our existing showrooms and on.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the moderation in annual volumes reflects a strategic shift toward higher-value sales and temporary softness in consumer demand due to elevated gold prices.
demand_outlook.quote: The moderation in annual volumes reflects a strategic shift toward higher-value sales and temporary softness in consumer demand due to elevated gold prices, while quarterly stability highlights the underlying strength in core demand

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the sentiment for jewellery in the South is strong and people view gold as a need rather than a luxury.
demand_outlook.quote: So to add upon that, so generally in South, the sentiment for jewellery is pretty strong. So they go, I mean, generally in South, we go as per the muhurthams or the marriages and all. Yes, there are very good muhurthams compared to this year, next year. And more than that, irrespective of the gold price, where people in Andhra, Telangana are part of Tamil Nadu and Kerala. So it's more of a sentiment driven. So people look gold as a need than a luxury.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to open close to 10 silver jewelry showrooms.
capex_expansion.quote: So, we have planned to open close to 10 showrooms in that 5 to 6, we have finalized on the locations and all the agreements are in place.

capex_expansion.claim: Management intends to open a 6,000 plus square feet ultra-premium Visesha jewelry showroom in Visakhapatnam.
capex_expansion.quote: So, we are planning to open a 6000 plus ultra premium showroom in Visakhapatnam that we have kind of finalized even on that.

capex_expansion.claim: The operational capex cost for setting up a silver store is estimated between INR5,000 to INR6,000 per square feet.
capex_expansion.quote: Grandhi Vittal: Yes. The average cost for the setting up a store will be anywhere between INR5 to INR6,000 per square feet.

capex_expansion.claim: The capex cost for setting up the Visesha premium store is expected to be around 8,000 to 9,000 per square feet.
capex_expansion.quote: So, this will cost around 8,000 to 9,000 per square feet.

capex_expansion.claim: The company opened its 18th showroom in Yellamanchili, Andhra Pradesh.
capex_expansion.quote: And when it comes to the number of showrooms and all, we have opened our 18th showroom two days back. It is in Yellamanchili, which is in the state of Andhra Pradesh.

capex_expansion.claim: Out of 8 showrooms planned after IPO proceeds, 5 have been opened and 3 more remain to be opened.
capex_expansion.quote: So out of 8 showrooms after the IPO proceeds, we have opened 5 showrooms, just 3 more are left and we will be opening in due course of time.

margins_costs.claim: The company experienced a dip in gross margins sequentially and year-on-year due to offering extra discounts and schemes.
margins_costs.quote: So what we try doing is, we try offering some better discounts for better walk-ins and better sales.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margins for gold jewelry are around 12% to 13%, while silver jewelry commands gross margins of 25% to 30%.
margins_costs.quote: Even though the GP around 12%to 13% in case of gold jewelry, it will be around 25% to 30% in case of silver jewellery.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margins for Visesha are projected around 18%, comparable to Polki jewelry.
margins_costs.quote: In terms of Visesha, we can equate with Polki and Polki jewelry, which were at the margin of around 18%.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that EBITDA improved in absolute terms, demonstrating operational efficiency from 375 Mn in Q3 to 456 Mn in Q4.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA improved in absolute terms demonstrating operational efficiency from 375 Mn in Q3 to 456 Mn in Q4(Growth of 22%)

margins_costs.claim: Q3 FY25 EBITDA stood at INR41.07 crores, registering a 6.20% increase year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA stands at INR41.07 crores, registering 6.20% increase with respect to the corresponding quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for Q3 FY25 was INR25.24 crores.
margins_costs.quote: And profit after tax is INR25.24 crores, registering a INR33.17 crores with respect to the corresponding quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: The total showroom count reached 21 showrooms after opening 6 more showrooms last year.
orders_capacity.quote: So now our entire count has been 21 showrooms from last year.

orders_capacity.claim: The silver jewelry stores are planned with an average size of around 2,000 to 2,500 square feet.
orders_capacity.quote: Average 2,000, around 2,000, 2,500 depending on area, but around 2,000 would be minimum. It can go up to 3,000 also.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sudden increases in gold prices act as a shock to customers who have been waiting to invest for occasions.
risks_headwinds.quote: So when there is sudden increase in gold prices, it's kind of a shock to anybody who has been waiting to invest for one or the other occasion.

management_commitments.claim: The Visesha ultra-premium showroom in Visakhapatnam is targeted to open by September.
Management stated that the remaining 3 showrooms out of the 8 planned post IPO proceeds will be opened by March this year.
management_commitments.quote: So out of 8 showrooms after the IPO proceeds, we have opened 5 showrooms, just 3 more are left and we will be opening in due course of time.

management_commitments.claim: Management expressed optimism about opening all three remaining stores before March 2025.
management_commitments.quote: We're optimistic to open all 3 stores before March ‘25.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
